mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT road_id) FROM road_monitor WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.device_id) FROM road_monitor r join sys_device d on r.device_id= d.id WHERE d.online_status = '在线' AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT SUM( (CASE WHEN pothole_num IS NOT NULL AND pothole_num_threshold IS NOT NULL AND pothole_num > pothole_num_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN crack_length IS NOT NULL AND crack_length_threshold IS NOT NULL AND crack_length > crack_length_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN road_temp IS NOT NULL AND road_temp_threshold IS NOT NULL AND road_temp > road_temp_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN traffic_flow IS NOT NULL AND traffic_flow_threshold IS NOT NULL AND traffic_flow > traffic_flow_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS over_count FROM road_monitor WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT road_id) FROM road_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( (pothole_num IS NOT NULL AND pothole_num_threshold IS NOT NULL AND pothole_num > pothole_num_threshold) OR (crack_length IS NOT NULL AND crack_length_threshold IS NOT NULL AND crack_length > crack_length_threshold) OR (road_temp IS NOT NULL AND road_temp_threshold IS NOT NULL AND road_temp > road_temp_threshold) OR (traffic_flow IS NOT NULL AND traffic_flow_threshold IS NOT NULL AND traffic_flow > traffic_flow_threshold) )
SELECT monitor_status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM road_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY monitor_status

SELECT '在线设备' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_device d INNER JOIN road_monitor rm ON rm.device_id = d.id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND rm.deleted = 0 AND d.online_status = '在线'
UNION ALL
SELECT '离线设备' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_device d INNER JOIN road_monitor rm ON rm.device_id = d.id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND rm.deleted = 0 AND d.online_status <> '在线'

SELECT rf.road_name AS name, SUM(rm.pothole_num) AS value FROM road_monitor rm LEFT JOIN road_facility rf ON rm.road_id = rf.id WHERE rm.deleted = 0 AND rf.deleted = 0 GROUP BY rm.road_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT rf.road_name AS name, SUM(rm.crack_length) AS value FROM road_monitor rm LEFT JOIN road_facility rf ON rm.road_id = rf.id WHERE rm.deleted = 0 AND rf.deleted = 0 GROUP BY rm.road_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT rf.area_name AS name, MAX(rm.traffic_flow) AS value FROM road_monitor rm LEFT JOIN road_facility rf ON rm.road_id = rf.id WHERE rm.deleted = 0 AND rf.deleted = 0 GROUP BY rf.area_name ORDER BY value DESC
